assumptions.rationale: Calibrated from JRC / NDMA flood depth-damage curves adjusted by sector (Agriculture ×1.12, Business ×1.08, Infrastructure ×0.92).

assumptions.value: 32% of direct commercial physical loss (in INR)
assumptions.rationale: Captures downtime from power/road disruption and supply-chain halt during 5–14 day recovery window.

assumptions.value: -18% to +21% around point estimate

limitations: Bundled demo scenario uses curated satellite-derived geometries paired with synthetic Indian Rupee (₹) insurance policy ledgers.
Sentinel-1 SAR can underestimate standing water beneath dense urban high-rises or mangrove canopies due to double-bounce backscatter.
